## Sessions

**0. Introduction to Difference-in-Differences**

[[Slides](00_mini_course_overview.html)]

* "Difference-in-Differences Designs: A Practitioner's Guide" ([Published](https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257%2Fjel.20251650), *Journal of Economic Literature*, 2026) ([Working Paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.13323))

* "Difference-in-Differences for Policy Evaluation" ([Published](https://link.springer.com/10.1007/978-3-319-57365-6_352-1), in *Handbook of Labor, Human Resources and Population Economics*, 2023) ([Working Paper](https://bcallaway11.github.io/files/Callaway-Chapter-2022/main.pdf))

* `R did` package [Website](https://bcallaway11.github.io/did)

**1. Difference-in-Differences with a Continuous Treatment**
[[Slides](01_continuous-treatment.html)]

* "Difference-in-Differences with a Continuous Treatment" ([Published](https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257%2Faer.20240137), forthcoming at the *American Economic Review*) ([Working Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.02637))

* The `contdid` R package (difference-in-differences with a continuous treatment): [GitHub](https://github.com/bcallaway11/contdid)

**2. Assessing the Plausibility of Strong Parallel Trends**
Using close comparison groups.
[[Slides](02_comparison-groups.html)]

* "Beyond Parallel Trends: An Identification-Strategy-Robust Approach to Causal Inference with Panel Data" ([Working Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21977))

**3. Shift-Share Instruments**
[[Slides](03_shift-share.html)]

* Goldsmith-Pinkham, Sorkin, and Swift. "Bartik Instruments: What, When, Why, and How." ([Published](https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257%2Faer.20181047), *American Economic Review*, 2020) ([Working Paper](https://www.nber.org/papers/w24408))

* de Chaisemartin and Lei. "More Robust Estimators for Instrumental-Variable Panel Designs, with an Application to the Effect of Imports from China on US Employment." ([Working Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.06437))

* Borusyak, Hull, and Jaravel. "A Practical Guide to Shift-Share Instruments." ([Published](https://www.aeaweb.org/articles?id=10.1257%2Fjep.20231370), *Journal of Economic Perspectives*, 2025) ([Working Paper](https://www.nber.org/papers/w33236))

* `R ssBartik` package [GitHub](https://github.com/takuma1102/ssBartik)
